summary: Oesterreichische Kontrollbank Aktiengesellschaft filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1,000,000,000 offering of 4.375% guaranteed global notes due 2031, guaranteed by the Republic of Austria, under its Global Issuance Facility. The notes price at 99.658%, with a 0.125% underwriting commission. Net proceeds finance export transactions. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No special-situation mechanics apply; watch for standard debt-market performance and secondary trading of the notes.
